decisions.reason: The rye country bread is an integral part of the firm's traditional rye range, and management has already justified keeping it, so it will continue to defend that choice.
The premium raisin stollen is the publicly declared flagship with repeated gold medals from the Deutsches Brotinstitut, so commitment and success both argue for keeping it.
The seeded rye mixed bread uses the established rye know-how and has its own page, so reversing the earlier decision to keep it would be hard to justify.
Although the dark barley malt rye is a niche variant, it shares existing facilities, and any softness in demand can still be blamed on temporary causes.
The marzipan stollen supports the flagship stollen line and the firm's committed Christmas gift direction, so dropping it would weaken that announced focus.
Having publicly presented the ancient grain bread as its newest masterpiece, management feels bound to give it more time rather than admit a misstep.
